economy.summary: Her campaign lists priorities of supporting childcare, fair wages, and family success, and of cutting red tape to create opportunities for local entrepreneurs and small businesses.
economy.short: Supports childcare, fair wages, small businesses; cutting red tape.

taxes.summary: Under a 'Responsible Tax Use' priority, her campaign calls to demand accountability and transparency in Harrisburg.
taxes.short: Calls for accountability and transparency on tax use in Harrisburg.

guns.summary: Under a 'Safe, Strong Communities' priority, her campaign says she will protect neighborhoods and back local law enforcement; the page does not detail a firearms position.
guns.short: Says she will protect neighborhoods and back local law enforcement.

economy.summary: Her stated priorities include supporting working families, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities, and standing with organized labor.
economy.short: Supports working families, seniors, veterans, disabled; stands with unions.

taxes.summary: She says she wants to reduce taxes for small and medium-sized businesses.
taxes.short: Wants to reduce taxes for small and medium-sized businesses.

education.summary: She says the state has begun to fully fund public education and invest in local municipalities, and lists education funding among her priorities.
education.short: Says state has begun fully funding public education; backs it.

abortion.summary: As a member of the state House, she cosponsored 2023 legislation (HB 428) addressing abortion and reproductive rights, which would repeal the Abortion Control Act and establish a Bodily Autonomy Act.
abortion.short: Cosponsored 2023 House bill addressing abortion and reproductive rights.

guns.summary: She hosted a May 2025 gun safety town hall focused on preventing gun violence and on safe storage of firearms, co-hosted with a community gun-safety partnership.
guns.short: Hosted 2025 gun safety town hall on preventing gun violence.
